material.title: State Grid releases a grid-forming storage interconnection standard for 2027
material.bodyOriginal: State Grid today released its grid-forming energy storage interconnection standard, setting voltage and frequency ride-through requirements that apply to new storage projects from 2027. The full text and an implementation guide are available.

material.title: 10 solar panel cleaning hacks that will surprise you
material.bodyOriginal: Solar is everywhere. Here are ten ways you can clean your rooftop panels, from vinegar sprays to DIY brushes. Sign up for our course to learn more.
